The 3Yiddish desktop app: talk Yiddish, get Yiddish text, on your own computer. Built on
[3Yiddish](https://github.com/TripleU613/3Yiddish) 0.6.0 by TripleU613.

**Which file?**

| Computer | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows | `3Yiddish-Desktop-windows-x64-setup.exe` |
| Mac, Apple chip (M1 and newer) | `3Yiddish-Desktop-macos-apple-silicon.dmg` |
| Linux | `3Yiddish-Desktop-linux-x64.AppImage`, or the `.deb` for Ubuntu/Debian/Mint |

The apps are not signed with a paid certificate yet, so Windows and macOS warn the first time.
The [README](https://github.com/MeilichM/3Yiddish#get-it) shows how to get past that.

**What's in it:** transcribe by talking (click the mic or hold Space) or by dropping in a
recording; two speech models to switch between; push-to-talk that types Yiddish into any
program (F9 by default); Chat that answers in Yiddish; Contribute; light and dark mode.
